 Bullets vs. Breakers Predictions - NBL Round 9 2026-27
 Editor-In-Chief 
 Daryl Curnow 
 Published: Wed 11 Nov 2026 6:04pm 
 Published: Wed 11 Nov 2026 6:04pm 
 Starts in 4m 19s 
 Match Details
 Date: Friday, 13 November 2026
Start Time: 5:30 PM (AEST)
Stadium: Spark Arena, Auckland
 The Breakers host the Bullets on Friday night at Spark Arena, where they look to end their losing streak. It’s going to be hard after losing early MVP candidate Parker Jackson-Cartwright to a season-ending injury, but they could perform at their best to honour their fallen captain.
 Best Bet
 Breakers @ $1.97
 Bet Now 
 The Breakers opened as betting favourites, but the loss of PJC is a hefty one for the home side. However, despite losing their point guard, we still have the Breakers beating the Bullets.
 They need something to go their way after a string of losses, and we’re looking at Sam Mennenga to step up. He has played well over the last few weeks, and the New Zealand international is good enough to carry this team to victory.
 We’re not surprised to see the Bullets firm into favouritism, but they would need to show something much better than what they showed last week against United. They lost 120-92, and if the defence doesn’t turn up, the Breakers can score points.
 It requires a full team effort from the Breakers, but they play well at Spark Arena, and having played only one of their last five games at home, they’ll get a welcome return from the Spark Arena faithful in Auckland.
 Same Game Multi
 Breakers H2H, Sam Mennenga 20+ Points, Reuben Te Rangi 4+ Rebounds, Total Points Over 185.5 @ $8.25
 Bet Now 
 Mennenga has recent scoring totals of 36, 22, 28, 15, and 29 points, so we’re taking the odds for him to score 20+ on Friday. Without Jackson-Cartwright, he’ll need to carry the offence, and he should easily go over the total.
 Reuben Te Rangi has four rebounds in two of his last five games, and the $1.84 odds for 4+ are worth taking. He should step into a role where he plays more minutes, so expect his numbers to increase this season.
 There should be more points than expected in this contest. We have over 185.5 points included in our NBL SGM picks.
 Best Value Bet
 Breakers 11+ @ $4.60
 Bet Now 
 The Breakers need something to go their way, and it could come via a big win over the Bullets.
 Playing at home is a big assist, and if they start well, they could put Brisbane under pressure early before pulling away late.
 The $4.60 odds are generous enough to include in NBL tips this week.
